name: Irritable
overview: Scripture instructs believers to exercise self-control in speech and emotions to prevent irritability and strife, emphasizing love for others as commanded by God. Proverbs highlights the wisdom of responding gently and guarding one's words to avoid anger and trouble, while Leviticus and Matthew remind us to love our neighbors without harboring grudges or hatred. Ephesians calls Christians to live in a manner worthy of their calling, reflecting Christ's patience and grace rather than impulsive or foolish outbursts.
